Terms.title: Terms of use
Terms.badge: Current version 2026-10-30 · draft pending legal review
Terms.lead: These rules apply to everyone who uses Hindama. By creating your account, and before your first project, you confirm that you accept them.
Terms.noteText: You may only test APIs you own or have written authorization to test. If you can't prove it, don't use Hindama on that API.

service.title: Purpose of the service
service.text: Hindama runs automated security tests on REST APIs based on their OpenAPI 3 contract and on the access policy declared by their owner.

responsible.title: Responsible use
responsible.text: You may only register and test APIs you own or for which you hold written authorization from their owner. Testing third-party APIs without authorization is prohibited and may be a crime.

ownership.title: Ownership verification
ownership.text: Before any test you must prove that you control the API's domain. The verification is checked again before every run.

limits.title: Limits and test environment
limits.text: We recommend using a test environment. The rate, concurrency, volume and duration limits you configure are respected at all times.

activity.title: Activity log
activity.text: Sensitive actions, such as creating projects, launching runs or accepting risks, are recorded in a log that cannot be altered.

suspension.title: Suspension
suspension.text: We may suspend accounts that breach these terms and keep the information needed to answer requests from authorities.

Privacy.title: Privacy notice
Privacy.badge: Draft pending legal review · version 1.0 · 30 Oct 2026
Privacy.lead: How we handle your personal data under Mexico's Federal Law on the Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties.

data.title: Data we collect
data.text: Name, email address and activity records of your account. From your projects we store the contract, the test identities with encrypted credentials and the results of the runs.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.text: To operate the platform, run the tests you request, generate reports and keep the service secure. We do not sell or share your data for commercial purposes.

credentials.title: Test credentials
credentials.text: They are stored encrypted and never shown in full: only their last 4 characters. In evidence and reports they appear masked.

retention.title: Retention and deletion
retention.text: When you delete a project or your account, the data is deleted from the database immediately. Backups overwrite it within 7 days and, at most, 30. The audit log is kept for 6 months.

audit.title: Log and anonymous metrics
audit.text: The log records what action happened and when, with an internal user identifier and a host fingerprint, never passwords or free text. Usage metrics are anonymous, are not personal data and are kept even if you delete your account.

rights.title: ARCO rights
rights.text: You exercise cancellation yourself by deleting your account from Profile. To access your data, correct it or object to its processing, write to the team's email: privacidad@hindama.mx. We respond within 20 business days at most.

changes.title: Changes to this notice
changes.text: We will publish any change on this page with its version date.

Home.meta: Hindama · Assess your API before you publish it
Home.badge: For teams that publish REST APIs
Home.title: Find your API's flaws before someone else does
Home.lead: Hindama tests your API's security from its OpenAPI 3 contract and from who should be able to do what. Every flaw comes with the request that reproduces it and stays with you until you fix it.

example.title: One user can read another user's orders
example.advice: Recommendation: check that the order belongs to the token's user.
example.caption: Sample finding and how it is tracked across runs.

early.title: Early detection
early.text: Test in your test environment before you publish, not after an incident.

contract.title: Guided by your contract
contract.text: Tests come from your OpenAPI 3 and from the access policy you confirm.

evidence.title: Actionable evidence
evidence.text: Every finding includes the request, the response, its OWASP and CWE category, and how to fix it.

followUp.title: Follow-up until closure
followUp.text: Test again and see what was resolved, what persists and what came back.

modules.title: Seven test modules
modules.subtitle: Based on the OWASP API Security Top 10 and CWE

config.name: Configuration
config.text: Security headers, CORS and error messages.

objects.name: Object access
objects.text: A user who reads or changes another user's objects.

functions.name: Function access
functions.text: Regular users who reach administrator functions.

properties.name: Properties
properties.text: Exposed or assignable fields that shouldn't be.

sql.name: SQL injection
sql.text: Parameters that reach the database unfiltered.

detect.title: Detect
detect.text: Run the modules with the rate limits you define.

fix.title: Fix
fix.text: Use each finding's evidence and recommendation.

retest.title: Test again
retest.text: Repeat the run with the same configuration in one step.

close.title: Close
close.text: The project is marked as concluded when no open flaws remain.

responsible.title: Responsible use
responsible.text: You may only test your own APIs or APIs you have written authorization from the owner to test. Before running tests, Hindama asks you to prove that you control the domain.

401.title: Your session ended
401.text: For security we end your session after a period of inactivity. Sign in again to continue.

403.title: This section isn't for your role
403.text: Administrators see statistics and the audit log, but not the content of projects.

404.title: We couldn't find this page
404.text: The link may be mistyped, or the project no longer exists or isn't yours.

429.title: Too many requests
429.text: You made more than 100 requests in a minute. Wait a moment and try again.

500.title: Something went wrong on our side
500.text: It's not your fault. We've already logged it. If it keeps happening, write to us with this reference code.

503.title: Service unavailable
503.text: Part of Hindama isn't responding right now. Your data is safe; try again in a few minutes.

noResults.title: Nothing matches your filters
noResults.text: Try another severity or clear the filters to see everything.

loadError.title: We couldn't load {subject}
loadError.text: It's a problem on our side. Your data is safe.

forbidden.title: You don't have permission to see this
forbidden.text: This content belongs to another account or another role.

rateLimited.title: Too many requests
rateLimited.text: Wait a moment before trying again.

unavailable.title: The service is unavailable
unavailable.text: We're restoring it. Your runs in progress are not lost.

url_no_tls.title: The base URL uses unencrypted HTTP
url_no_tls.text: Test credentials would travel unprotected. Use HTTPS if your API allows it; you can continue with HTTP if the environment is for testing.

url_unresolved.title: The host doesn't resolve in DNS yet
url_unresolved.text: We saved the project anyway. You'll be able to verify ownership once the DNS record exists.

project_verification_lost.title: You changed the host and verification was lost
project_verification_lost.text: Verify ownership again before running tests. Changing only the path or port doesn't affect verification.

contract_servers_mismatch.title: The contract declares servers different from your base URL
contract_servers_mismatch.text: Tests always target the project's base URL. Confirm it's the right one.

contract_external_reference.title: The contract uses external references
contract_external_reference.text: We don't download references to other files or sites, so those parts aren't analyzed.

contract_unparsed_element.title: An element of the contract couldn't be interpreted
contract_unparsed_element.text: We skipped it and imported the rest. Location in the document:

contract_unchanged.title: This version is identical to the previous one
contract_unchanged.text: There are no changes to record, so we didn't create a new version.

PendingResources.title: {count, plural, one {# resource was left undeleted in your API} other {# resources were left undeleted in your API}}
PendingResources.text: Hindama created them during this run and couldn't delete them after 3 attempts. Delete them by hand to leave your environment clean. Errors are shown without credentials.

AcceptRisk.placeholder: Explain why this risk is accepted

AcceptRisk.tooShort: Write a justification of at least {min} characters.
